SELECT p.patrol_type AS patrolType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM patrols p WHERE GROUP BY p.patrol_type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT p.area_id AS areaId, a.area_name AS areaName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM patrols p LEFT JOIN prison_areas a ON p.area_id = a.id AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE GROUP BY p.area_id, a.area_name ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT p.guard_id AS guardId, g.name AS guardName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM patrols p LEFT JOIN guards g ON p.guard_id = g.id AND g.deleted = 0 WHERE GROUP BY p.guard_id, g.name ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT HOUR(p.patrol_time) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS count FROM patrols p WHERE GROUP BY HOUR(p.patrol_time) ORDER BY hour

SELECT p.id, DATE_FORMAT(p.patrol_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS patrolTime, p.patrol_type AS patrolType, p.result, p.description, p.guard_id AS guardId, g.name AS guardName, p.area_id AS areaId, a.area_name AS areaName FROM patrols p LEFT JOIN guards g ON p.guard_id = g.id AND g.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN prison_areas a ON p.area_id = a.id AND a.deleted = 0 WHERE ORDER BY p.patrol_time DESC
